stillo: Calm focus and fewer distractions; short, soft-sounding and easy to say.
easevo: A companion that makes difficult work feel easier; suggests ease without naming one feature.
seriva: A gentle companion brand with room to grow beyond a single utility.
duetio: A collaborative operator: you and an intelligent partner working as a duet.
allyva: A helpful agent crew; suggests an ally while keeping an independent brand sound.
meshva: An orchestration layer that connects agents, tools and workflows.
thredo: Persistent context across tasks and conversations; a compact spelling inspired by thread.
echori: A memory companion that brings useful past context back into the present.
jotva: Quick capture, notes and recall; a small name for a focused memory utility.
glimpi: A quick view of what matters: a visual assistant, insight feed or situational awareness tool.
lumiro: A visual intelligence brand with a warm, expansive sound.
prismio: Multiple perspectives on one problem; suitable for analysis or visual intelligence.
nudgi: A friendly proactive assistant that supplies the next useful nudge.
glidi: An operator that helps work move smoothly; short and light to pronounce.
sprynt: A brisk execution product; memorable, but the altered spelling needs to be explained aloud.
nimvo: A friendly invented companion name with no claimed dictionary meaning.
bimlo: A compact mascot-style SI name; playful enough for a consumer product.
pebzi: A distinctive small companion name; deliberately invented for its spoken sound.
wiblo: An approachable assistant name, playful rather than technical.
tidyva: A useful organising assistant for files, messages or everyday admin.
clipva: A narrow capture-and-reuse tool: clipping useful material into an intelligent workspace.
patchva: An agent that helps repair small problems and complete unfinished work.
weavi: A creation tool that weaves sources, ideas or agents into something useful.
loomva: An SI workshop brand for assembling useful outputs from many threads.
feltva: A warmer, tactile name for a design or personal companion product.
